# `db/queries/enrichment-runs.ts`

## Overview

Provides query helpers for creating and retrieving enrichment run records associated with tasks. Enrichment runs track the execution of individual enrichers — including their status, cost, duration, and result payload. The `mergeResults` utility aggregates completed run results into a single merged object for downstream consumption.

---

## Exports

### `recordRun`

Records a single enricher run for a task.

```ts
import { recordRun } from 'db/queries/enrichment-runs'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function recordRun(
  taskId: string,
  enricher: string,
  status: string,
  result?: Record<string, unknown>,
  costUsd?: number,
  durationMs?: number,
  error?: string
): Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  status: string;
  taskId: string;
  costUsd: string | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  enricher: string;
  result: unknown;
  error: string | null;
}>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `taskId` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the task this run belongs to. |
| `enricher` | `string` | Yes | Identifier for the enricher that was executed. |
| `status` | `string` | Yes | The outcome status of the run (e.g. `"success"`, `"error"`). |
| `result` | `Record<string, unknown>` | No | Optional JSONB result payload produced by the enricher. |
| `costUsd` | `number` | No | Optional cost of the run in US dollars. |
| `durationMs` | `number` | No | Optional wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds. |
| `error` | `string` | No | Optional error message if the run failed. |

#### Returns

A `Promise` that resolves to the newly created enrichment run record.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Auto-generated record ID. |
| `createdAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the record was created. |
| `status` | `string` | Status of the run as stored. |
| `taskId` | `string` | ID of the associated task. |
| `costUsd` | `string \| null` | Cost in USD, serialized as a string (database numeric type). |
| `durationMs` | `number \| null` | Duration in milliseconds. |
| `enricher` | `string` | Enricher identifier. |
| `result` | `unknown` | The result JSONB payload. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Error message, if any. |

#### Example

```ts
const run = await recordRun(
  'task-abc-123',
  'web-scraper',
  'success',
  { title: 'Example Page', wordCount: 412 },
  0.002,
  1340,
)

console.log(run.id)       // e.g. 7
console.log(run.costUsd)  // e.g. "0.002"
```

### `listByTask`

Returns all enrichment runs for a task, ordered by `createdAt` ascending.

```ts
import { listByTask } from 'db/queries/enrichment-runs'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function listByTask(
  taskId: string
): Promise<{
  id: number;
  createdAt: Date | null;
  status: string;
  taskId: string;
  costUsd: string | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  enricher: string;
  result: unknown;
  error: string | null;
}[]>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `taskId` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the task whose runs should be retrieved. |

#### Returns

A `Promise` that resolves to an array of enrichment run records ordered by `createdAt` ascending. Returns an empty array if no runs exist for the given task. Each element in the array has the same shape as the record returned by [`recordRun`](#recordrun).

#### Example

```ts
const runs = await listByTask('task-abc-123')

for (const run of runs) {
  console.log(`${run.enricher}: ${run.status} (${run.durationMs}ms)`)
}
```

### `mergeResults`

Fetches all completed runs for a task and deep-merges their result JSONB into a single object. Later enrichers override earlier ones for conflicting keys.

```ts
import { mergeResults } from 'db/queries/enrichment-runs'
```

#### Signature

```ts
async function mergeResults(
  taskId: string
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `taskId` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the task whose completed run results should be merged. |

#### Returns

A `Promise` that resolves to a single `Record<string, unknown>` representing the deep-merged result of all completed enrichment runs. When two enrichers produce values for the same key, the value from the **later** enricher (by `createdAt`) takes precedence.

> **Note:** Only completed runs contribute to the merged output. Runs with non-completed statuses are excluded.

#### Example

```ts
// Given two completed runs with results:
//   enricher-1: { category: 'news', wordCount: 300 }
//   enricher-2: { category: 'tech' }              ← runs later
const merged = await mergeResults('task-abc-123')

console.log(merged)
// { category: 'tech', wordCount: 300 }
```
